title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Door may Open While Driving (1,455 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US LLC) is recalling certain model year 2013-2014 Dodge Viper vehicles manufactured October 1, 2012, to February 6, 2014.  Moisture may get into the door switch, resulting in the driver or passenger door opening unexpectedly while the vehicle is in motion.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Electric Propulsion System may Shutdown (5,660 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US LLC) is recalling certain model year 2013-2015 Fiat 500 EV vehicles manufactured March 27, 2012, to November 1, 2014.  If the vehicle goes in to limp home mode, incompatible software between Electric Vehicle Control Unit (EVCU) and Battery Pack Control Module (BPCM) may cause the electric propulsion system to fully shut down.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: Inverter may Fail and Cause Fire (23 affected)
summary: Blue Bird Body Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain model year 2015-2016 Vision non-school transit buses manufactured June 19, 2014, to December 11, 2014.  In the affected vehicles, the voltage inverter for the illumination of the driver's heater control panel may fail.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: Inverter may Fail and Cause Fire (2,663 affected)
summary: Blue Bird Body Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain model year 2015-2016 Vision school buses manufactured June 19, 2014, to December 11, 2014.  In the affected vehicles, the voltage inverter for the illumination of the driver's heater control panel may fail.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Kidde Handheld Fire Extinguisher may not Discharge (2,226 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain model year 2014-2015 Western Star 4700, 4900, 5700, and 6900 trucks manufactured from July 23, 2013, through December 4, 2014, and equipped with certain Kidde disposable handheld fire extinguishers.  These fire extinguishers may not fully discharge as designed when the lever is repeatedly pressed and released.

title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: Seat Belt may not properly Restrain Driver (21 affected)
summary: Motor Coach Industries (MCI) is recalling certain model year 2007-2010 MCI E4500 and J4500 motor coaches manufactured November 21, 2006, to August 27, 2009, and equipped with certain Recaro Automotive Seating Ergo M bus driver seats.  The affected seats were manufactured in a way that the tether bar may push into the retractor panel door and potentially interfere with the seat belt locking mechanism.

title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: Tie Rod Nuts may be Incorrectly Torqued (131 affected)
summary: Motor Coach Industries (MCI) is recalling certain model year 2014 J4500 and model year 2015 D4000ISTV, D4005, D4500, and D4505 motor coaches manufactured August 26, 2014, to December 3, 2014.  The affected motor coaches have front and steerable tag axles whose tie rod nuts may be improperly torqued.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Improperly Seated Brake Chamber Diaphragm (3,732 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain model year 2015 Freightliner Cascadia, Business Class M2, 108SD, 114SD, 122SD, Coronado, Western Star 4700, and Western Star 4900 trucks manufactured October 6, 2014, to February 16, 2015, and equipped with Haldex Life Seal brake chambers.  The affected vehicles may experience brake drag due to an improperly seated diaphragm in the brake chamber.

title: DS Corp - DBA Crossroads RV: Slide Room may Extend While Vehicle is in Motion (62 affected)
summary: DS Corp, doing business as Crossroads RV (Crossroads), is recalling certain model year 2016 Crossroads Sunset Trail, Cruiser Aire, Cruiser, Cameo, and ReZerve recreational trailers manufactured March 4, 2015, to March 20, 2015.  In the affected vehicles, the screws that attach the expanding room to the sliding mechanism cable may fail allowing the room to extend unintentionally while the vehicle is in motion.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Abutting Wedge Incorrectly Installed (378 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain model year 2015 Coachmen Prism recreational vehicles manufactured from July 1, 2014, through October 14, 2014 and built on Mercedes-Benz Sprinter chassis.  In the affected vehicles, the abutting wedge, a component attached to the door jamb to make opening the door easier after a severe frontal impact, may have been installed incorrectly.

title: Ohlins Racing AB: Shock Absorber Damping Rod Nut may Loosen/Detach (964 affected)
summary: Ohlins Racing AB (Ohlins) is recalling certain TTX36 aftermarket motorcycle shock absorbers manufactured November 5, 2013, to February 20, 2015.  A complete list of the affected models and the motorcycles that they fit can be viewed by clicking on file RCORRD-15E025-7729.pdf under Associated Documents.  The nut on the damper rod for these shock absorbers may loosen, resulting in a loss of damping and the possible disassembling of the shock.

title: Buy4easy Inc: Penetration Test Failure/FMVSS 218 (12,181 affected)
summary: Buy4easy Inc (Buy4easy) is recalling certain TMS JX-A5005 full face helmets with visors, sizes S, M, L, and XL, manufactured from April 1, 2012, to July 15, 2013.  The affected motorcycle helmets failed the penetration test.  Additionally, the helmet label does not meet DOT regulations.  As such, these helmets fail to meet the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) No. 218, "Motorcycle Helmets."

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Rear Reflex Reflectors/FMVSS 108 (13,443 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain model year 2013 528i, 528i xDrive, 535i, 535i xDrive, 550i, 550i xDrive, and ActiveHybrid 5 vehicles.  The rear reflex reflectors may not reflect enough light.  As such, the vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Improper Plating on Fuel Pump may Result in Stall (18,054 affected)
summary: BMW of North America LLC (BMW) is recalling certain model year 2014 228i Coupe, M235i Coupe, 320i, 320xi, 328i, 328xi, 335i, 335xi, ActiveHybrid 3, 328xi Sports Wagon, 428i Coupe, 428xi Coupe, 435i Coupe, 435xi Coupe, 428i Convertible, 428xi Convertible, 435i Convertible, 328xi Gran Turismo, 335xi Gran Turismo, and 2015 428i Gran Coupe, 428xi Gran Coupe, and 435i Gran Coupe vehicles.  Improper nickel plating of components within the fuel pump may result in the fuel pump failing.

title: Airstream, Inc.: Abutting Wedge Incorrectly Installed (180 affected)
summary: Airstream, Inc. (Airstream) is recalling certain model year 2015 Interstate motorhomes manufactured from October 6, 2014, through March 25, 2015, and built on a Mercedes-Benz Sprinter chassis.  In the affected vehicles, the abutting wedge, a component attached to the door jamb to make opening the door easier after a severe frontal crash, may have been installed incorrectly.

title: Thor Motor Coach: Abutting Wedge Incorrectly Installed (197 affected)
summary: Thor Motor Coach (Thor) is recalling certain model year 2015 Siesta and Citation motorhomes manufactured from September 26, 2014, through February 27, 2015, and built on a Mercedes-Benz Sprinter chassis.  In the affected vehicles, the abutting wedge, a component attached to the door jamb to make opening the door easier after a severe frontal crash, may have been installed incorrectly.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Steering Gear Mounting Bolts May Break (5,058 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain model year 2014-2015 Smart Fortwo Coupes and Convertibles, and 2014 Fortwo Coupe Electric and Fortwo Convertible Electric vehicles.  The affected vehicles have steering gear mounting bolts which may break during vehicle operation.

title: Rapala Recalls StrikeMaster Ice Augers Due To Injury Hazard
summary: The trigger switch on the auger could fail and the unit not turn off, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 3,000 in the United States and 60 in Canada.

title: Children's Pajamas Recalled by KTM North America for Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The pajamas fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 2,800.

title: Dirt Devil Recalls Hand Vac Turbo Tool Accessory Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The interior fan of the Turbo Tool accessory can break and eject from the tool housing, posing a laceration hazard to the user or bystanders. Units: About 22,000 in the United States and about 2,500 in Canada.

title: Melville Direct Recalls Aquarium Motion Lamps Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively by Bits & Pieces (Recall Alert)
summary: The lamp can overheat and spark when plugged in, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,600.

title: Dream on Me Recalls 2-in-1 Bassinet to Cradle Due to Fall and Suffocation Hazards
summary: The wire supports on the sides of the bassinet can disconnect causing the fabric sides to lower; posing a risk that infants can fall out or become entrapped and suffocate. Units: About 13,000.

title: Flow Sports Inc. Recalls Snowboard Bindings Due to Fall Hazard
summary: A pin can disengage and cause the binding to open, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 10,400.

title: Child’s Catastrophic Brain Injury Prompts Recall of Residential Elevators Sold Exclusively by Coastal Carolina Elevators Due to Crushing Hazard
summary: The elevator can operate while the gate door is open, posing a crushing hazard. Units: About 240.

title: Spinrite Recalls Bernat Tizzy Yarn Due to Entanglement Hazard
summary: In finished knit or crochet items, the yarn can unravel or snag and form a loop, posing an entanglement hazard to young children. Units: About 620,000 in the U.S and about 220,000 in Canada.

title: CreaMiser Refrigerated Creamer Dispensers Recalled by WhiteWave Due to Fire Hazard
summary: A relay inside the creamer dispensers can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 5,600.

title: Levels of Discovery Recalls Airplane Rocker Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The red wooden knobs on the rocker's steering panel console can detach, posing a small parts choking hazard to young children. Units: About 150.

title: Westinghouse Lighting Recalls Glass Shade Holders Due to Risk of Electrical Shock; Sold at Home Depot Stores
summary: The pull chain switch on the glass shade holder is incorrectly wired, posing a shock hazard to the consumer. Units: About 5,000.

title: Youth Loungewear Pants Recalled by M&M'S World Store Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The youth loungewear pants fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injury to children. Units: About 19,000.

title: Kid's Korner Children's Zipper Hooded Sweatshirts Recalled by Kroger Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The sweatshirt zipper pull can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 140,000.

title: SCARPA North America Recalls Ski Boots with Tronic System Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The Tronic system, can unexpectedly switch from ski mode to walk mode, not allowing the boot to release from the binding, posing a fall or injury hazard. Units: About 2100 in U.S. and 250 in Canada.

title: Urban Outfitters Recalls Teacups Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The tea cups are mislabeled as microwave safe. If microwaved, the gold paint accents on the teacups can spark, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 11,640 units in the United States and 1,730 in Canada.

title: Children's Pajamas Recalled by K.J. Sportswear California Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The pajamas fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injury to children. Units: About 9,200.

title: efco Expands Recall of Gas Trimmers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The muffler on the engine can break during use and pose a fire hazard. Units: About 1,900 in the United States and 200 in Canada. This product was previously recalled in December 2013.

title: Bauer Hockey Recalls Hockey Goalie Masks and Replacement Wires Due to Facial Impact or Laceration Hazard
summary: The metal wires on the cages can break, posing a facial impact or laceration hazard. Units: About 1,200 in the U.S. and 1,300 in Canada.

title: Blinds To Go Recalls Window Shades Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The shade's chain or cord loop can slip out of the hold-down device, posing a strangulation hazard for small children. Units: About 200,000.

title: Giant Factories Recalls Water Heaters Due to Risk of Fire, Explosion
summary: On units with a space between the bottom of the water tank and the combustion chamber, the flame arrestor or flame arrestor plate can fail, posing a risk of fire or explosion if flammable liquids or gases are nearby. Units: About 240.

title: Lands' End Recalls Children's Pajamas and Robes Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard (Recall Alert)
summary: The pajamas and robes fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 173,000.

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Aerobars Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bolt used to affix the aerobars to the bicycle can loosen, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 8,300.

title: Linon Home Décor Products Recalls Foldable Wood Patio Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chair can unexpectedly tip over when a consumer sits on the edge of the seat, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 3,300.
